description: Decay factors of STANDARD v1.2.0 section 8.1: max(0.5 ** (age / half_life), min_trust), or 0.5 ** (age / half_life) when the model sets no min_trust, the recency_factor of schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml. The factor is exactly 0.5 at one half-life before the floor; min_trust floors the factor only, and a floor above 0.5 holds it from the age at which the curve reaches it; an age below zero counts as zero. The half-life is a duration of whole days, P<n>D with n at least 1: another form, or a min_trust outside 0 to 1, makes the model invalid, and an implementation refuses it (expect_error). Normative (section 10.3): an implementation that computes trust scores gives each vector's decay_factor within `tolerance`, and refuses each vector with expect_error. grounded_agency/trust.py is the reference implementation; tests/test_trust.py runs it against this file.

fields.name: The vector's name, unique in this file.
fields.half_life: decay_model.half_life: an ISO 8601 duration of whole days, as schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml writes it.
fields.min_trust: decay_model.min_trust. Absent: the model sets no floor.
fields.age_hours: The age of the observation, in hours.
fields.decay_factor: The expected decay factor, absent when expect_error is true. A conforming value differs from it by at most `tolerance`.
fields.expect_error: true: the model or the age is invalid and an implementation refuses it; the vector then has no decay_factor.

vectors.name: no_age
vectors.about: An observation made now has lost nothing.

vectors.name: one_half_life
vectors.about: At an age of one half-life the factor is 0.5. A time constant, exp(-age / half_life), gives 0.3679 here and does not conform.

vectors.name: half_an_hour
vectors.about: An age that is a fraction of an hour: 0.5 ** (0.5 / 240).

vectors.name: floor_reached
vectors.about: With the shipped values, half_life P10D and min_trust 0.25, the factor reaches the floor at two half-lives: 0.5 ** 2.

vectors.name: floored_at_three_half_lives
vectors.about: 0.5 ** 3 is 0.125, below min_trust: the factor is min_trust.

vectors.name: floored_at_a_hundred_years
vectors.about: Age alone never takes the factor below min_trust.

vectors.name: no_min_trust_at_three_half_lives
vectors.about: The model sets no min_trust, so nothing floors the factor: 0.5 ** 3.

vectors.name: half_life_of_one_day
vectors.about: The half-life is configurable. With P1D, 36 hours are one and a half half-lives: 0.5 ** 1.5.

vectors.name: half_life_of_thirty_days
vectors.about: With P30D, 720 hours are one half-life.

vectors.name: min_trust_above_half
vectors.about: A floor above 0.5 applies: at one half-life the factor is min_trust, 0.6; before the floor, the curve is 0.5 there.

vectors.name: min_trust_above_half_young
vectors.about: Above the floor, the curve applies: 0.5 ** 0.1, above 0.6.

vectors.name: negative_age_counts_as_zero
vectors.about: Evidence dated a day after the time the score is computed: its age counts as zero, so it is never fresher than a present observation.

vectors.name: half_life_not_days
vectors.about: A half-life of another form than P<n>D is invalid.

vectors.name: half_life_zero
vectors.about: A half-life of zero days is invalid.

vectors.name: min_trust_out_of_range
vectors.about: A min_trust outside 0 to 1 is invalid.
